basic_info.description: HUGE Price Change!! Don't miss this great opportunity.  Perfectly situated top floor corner unit with views in award winning Stanley Saitowitz designed building. Features open floor-plan, 9ft ceilings, French balconies, radiant heat, Miele appliances, European cabinetry, hardwood floors, in unit washer & dryer and a walk-in closet upgraded by California Closets. The building has a common roof deck with expansive views. The unit has a large parking space and secured storage. Close to Divisadero shops, restaurants, Japan Town, Kaiser and UCSF.
